before: External Word acceptance or rejection could leave retained application property/atomic metadata pending after its native fallback revisions disappeared.
after: A private inspection reports exact pending, externally accepted/rejected, resolved, or conflicting blocks. One guarded metadata-only transaction reconciles unambiguous values through existing immutable decision receipts and preserves every native Word part.
reason: The feature uses existing payload/receipt codecs and native package-edit primitives. It does not recreate revisions, replace Word text, infer properties from free text, or change native/private shared formats. Group and legacy property/atomic decisions share the same reentry guard. Complete staged removal/field preflight and private history-4 ownership stay in force. Ambiguous external content remains unchanged and reports a conflict. Desktop Microsoft Word capture remains V06.
